likeness_references.camera: Canon PowerShot SX260 HS (EXIF); EXIF Software 'Microsoft Windows Photo Viewer 6.1.7600.16385'
likeness_references.date_precision: Day, as the source states it: the Commons Information Date field reads 2013-07-07 and the file name ends 20130707; the embedded EXIF DateTimeOriginal is 2013:07:07 15:54:28 (camera clock, not independently verified). Not capture dates: the EXIF DateTime 2013:07:07 17:13:33 written by Windows Photo Viewer (a later save, probably a rotation) and the Commons upload of 22 July 2013. The election-campaign context agrees with the date but is not used to prove it.
likeness_references.depiction: Natsuo Yamaguchi, the central man, waist-up, giving an outdoor street speech during the 2013 House of Councillors election campaign in strong sunlight: white shirt with thin blue stripes and rolled-up sleeves, no jacket or tie, a cluster of microphones held in his right hand and his left hand raised in a loose fist, a silver metal wristwatch on his left wrist. The en description reads 'Natsuo Yamaguchi (President of Kōmeitō).' and the ja description '公明党代表山口那津男。投稿者が撮影' (taken by the uploader). Categories: Natsuo Yamaguchi in 2013; Japanese House of Councillors election, 2013; Taken with Canon PowerShot SX260 HS. The place is not stated for this file; the same photographer's same-day File:Japanese House of Councillors election, 2013 (07) IMG 5611 20130707.JPG, described as Umeda, Osaka, shows the same shop window, shrub and striped shirt, so Umeda is probable, not established.
likeness_references.creator: Ogiyoshisan (Wikimedia Commons user), own work
likeness_references.credit: Ogiyoshisan, 'Natsuo Yamaguchi IMG 5607 20130707.JPG' (own work), photograph of 7 July 2013, CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0), via Wikimedia Commons (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Natsuo_Yamaguchi_IMG_5607_20130707.JPG). Adapted (redrawn as a cartoon) for Spheres; no endorsement implied.
likeness_references.source_license_statement: Commons LicenseShortName exactly 'CC BY 3.0' (License 'cc-by-3.0', UsageTerms 'Creative Commons Attribution 3.0', AttributionRequired true); wikitext licence template {{cc-by-3.0}} with Source {{Own}} and Author Ogiyoshisan. Unported 3.0, not a jurisdiction port.
likeness_references.rights_statement: CC BY 3.0 by the photographer Ogiyoshisan, own work. Attribution to Ogiyoshisan with the licence link and a statement that the image was adapted is required for the generated cartoon. No share-alike term. The copied bytes are the untouched 1200x1600 original (single Commons file version).
likeness_references.identity_basis: The Commons descriptions name him (en and ja), the file is in Category:Natsuo Yamaguchi in 2013, his features match the 2019 reference (swept-back dark hair, long oval face, high cheekbones, prominent ears), and the photographer's same-day IMG 5611 (CC BY 3.0, viewed at 1280 px) shows the same man in the same shirt speaking from behind a railing above a campaign poster whose printed portrait matches him.
likeness_references.people_in_frame: Yamaguchi is the central, nearest figure. Also in frame: a man in a white shirt and glasses partly visible at the left edge; the dark-haired head of a man behind Yamaguchi's left shoulder; a dark-clothed figure and a blue panel at the right edge. Microphones (one with a brown windscreen) and their cables, a metal railing and a black panel in the foreground; a shrub at the left; a building facade with a shop window behind. The prompt excludes everything except Yamaguchi.
likeness_references.appearance_observed: Thick very dark, almost black hair combed back from the forehead with a slight sideways sweep into a full, rounded shape with volume on top, short at the sides with the ears uncovered; no gray discernible at this resolution; long oval face with high cheekbones and lean cheeks; smile lines; narrow dark eyes under heavy lids (squinting in the sun); fairly straight dark brows; straight nose with a slightly broad base; wide mouth (open, speaking); firm chin; prominent ears; light warm complexion; clean shaven; no glasses; slim. Clothing: white shirt with thin blue stripes, button-down collar, sleeves rolled to mid-forearm; dark trousers and belt partly visible; silver metal wristwatch. The slightly soft compact-camera image has JPEG noise and harsh sunlight.
likeness_references.age_gap_note: Photograph of 7 July 2013: 1,398 days (about 3.8 years) after the early part's start of 2009-09-08 and 543 days (about 1.5 years) before its exclusive end of 2015-01-01; 428 days (about 1.2 years) after that part's midpoint of 2012-05-05. Yamaguchi (born 12 July 1952, general knowledge) is 60 in the photograph, five days before his 61st birthday, and 57 to 62 across the early part. The prompt asks for about 60, as in the photograph. One dated image is not proof of his appearance in every year of the part.
likeness_references.limitation: Slightly soft compact-camera photograph in harsh sun; waist-up; campaign shirtsleeves rather than a suit. The suit, tie, trousers, standing pose and shoes are artistic extensions; suit, shirt and tie colours follow the 2 January 2013 photograph recorded under clothing_colour_source (text only, not an input).
likeness_references.visual_inspection_note: The full 1200x1600 original was viewed, with face and hair crops; the same-day IMG 5611 and the 2 January 2013 file were viewed for corroboration.
